# Spain

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Asociacion Espanola de Banca (AEB)

**Role:** Spanish banking association and domestic SEPA implementation-booklet publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Payment initiation and payment status; no national CAMT 052/053/054 implementation guide verified in the public AEB catalog.

**Messages / versions:** pain.001.001.09; pain.002.001.10; pain.008

- [Official SEPA payment booklets](https://aebanca.es/sector-bancario/documentos-de-interes-sectorial/operativa-bancaria/folletos-de-pago-sepa/) — availability; public-page
- [ISO 20022 credit transfers and euro cheques, November 2025](https://aebanca.es/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Folleto.-Ordenes-en-formato-ISO-20022-para-emision-de-transferencias-y-cheques-en-euros-noviembre-2025.pdf) — payment-guideline; public-file

Public 57-page 2025 transfer booklet explicitly scopes itself to pain 001 v09 and 002 v10. Landing also links 2025 SDD Core/B2B booklets. Account-information flow diagrams do not mean CAMT reporting is specified. Historical Cuaderno 43 is not CAMT.
